records.part: Additional 15kV switchgear section (line-up) with vacuum circuit breakers added onto existing 15kV switchgear at RPEAK

records.part: Evaporative coolers and natural gas compression installation on generators to improve efficiency
records.reason: The installation of natural gas compression will increase the pressure of the incoming natural gas from the local distribution system to the pressure the TM2500 generators were designed to run at for full nameplate capability.
